'''Alex Tennet Skywalker Projections''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Alex Tennet]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls127.htm Skywalker Projections], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027103424/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls127.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
